# Chataptor for WordPress — Multilingual Live Chat Plugin

Canonical URL: https://chataptor.com/en/integrations/wordpress/
Markdown URL: https://chataptor.com/markdown/en/integrations/wordpress.md
Language: English (en)
Add a multilingual live chat widget to your WordPress site. Auto-translate conversations in real-time. Free plugin with WooCommerce support.

## Overview
Multilingual Live Chat for WordPress
Add a real-time chat widget to your WordPress site. Your customers write in their language, you reply in yours — Chataptor translates everything automatically.

## Key Features
- Auto-Translation: Messages are translated in real-time between your language and your customer's. Powered by DeepL & OpenAI.
- Omnichannel Inbox: Manage conversations from your website, WhatsApp, Messenger, and email — all in one dashboard.
- AI Chatbots: Set up automated responses powered by AI. Handle common questions 24/7 in any language.
- 1-Click Install: Install from WordPress.org, paste your API key, done. No coding required. Works with any theme.

## How It Works
- Install Plugin: Search "Chataptor" in WordPress Plugins and click Install. Activate with one click.
- Connect Account: Enter your Chataptor API key in Settings. Free account includes all features.
- Start Chatting: The widget appears on your site. Chat with visitors from your Chataptor dashboard.

## Platform Fit
Built for e-commerce
Deep WooCommerce integration gives you customer context right in the chat.
- Order Context: See customer's recent orders, cart contents, and purchase history alongside the conversation.
- HPOS Ready: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage for maximum speed.
- Customer ID: Automatically identifies logged-in WooCommerce customers by name and email.

## Technical Requirements
- WordPress: 6.0+
- PHP: 7.4+
- WooCommerce: 8.0+
- Theme: Any

## FAQ
### Is the plugin really free?
Yes. The WordPress plugin is free, and Chataptor is currently free to use with no message limits. You can add live chat and handle customer conversations without planning a separate budget upfront.

### How many languages are supported?
Chataptor supports 30+ languages with automatic real-time translation. Your customers write in their native language, and you see everything translated to yours.

### Does it work with page builders like Elementor?
Yes. The widget loads as a small script tag and works independently of your theme or page builder. Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder — all supported.

### Is it GDPR compliant?
Yes. Chataptor is fully GDPR/RODO compliant. Data is processed in the EU, and the plugin includes a configurable privacy notice for visitors.
